commit_message:
Skip serialization of huge vibration effects in NotificationChannel

Instead of trying to do this approximately on unparceling, we do it more lightly there, and then exactly on serialization.

(Doing it exactly on unparceling is technically feasible, and actually used to be the case previously, but has too much of an impact on performance).
